text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "For this groundbreaking project, Swisscom AG and Ernst Basler + Partner (EBP) were awarded the 2016 Watt d'Or in the “Buildings and space” category.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "In combination with the installation of an innovative automated ventilation system, an outstanding overall concept was developed for this project: the complex is especially noteworthy for its degree of comfort and its energy-efficient design, which meets the requirements of the Minergie-P-Eco standard, as well as for its low operating costs and high degree of operational safety."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Prix spécial «Stratégie d'entreprise»\nCoop – Vision en matière d'énergie et de CO2: des paroles aux actes", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Special “Corporate strategy” award\nCoop Group – energy and CO2 vision: deeds instead of words"}]}
